text: The Board further confirms this nominee is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint this nominated candidate. Applegrove’s Board of Management recently received delayed notification that at the organizational meeting of the Toronto District School Board held on November 15, 2021, the Board nominated Trustee Michelle Aarts as its representative on the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management for the term November 15, 2021 to November 14, 2022.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate for appointment to the Applegrove Community Complex Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for the term of office noted below and until a successor is appointed: - Michelle Aarts for a term of office ending November 14, 2022
